# graphifyy → @sentropic/graphify

> **`graphifyy` has moved to [`@sentropic/graphify`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@sentropic/graphify).**

This package is now a thin redirect: it depends on `@sentropic/graphify` and re-exports it (CLI + API), so existing installs keep working. Please switch your dependency to the new name:

```bash
npm install @sentropic/graphify
```

The CLI binary is unchanged (`graphify …`). Same tool, new home — now centered on knowledge graphs and entity reconciliation. See https://github.com/rhanka/graphify.
